name: [V1.3] Fruit Piece Incremental
desc:
⚔️FRUIT PIECE INCREMENTAL ⚔️

A text-based adventure inspired by one piece!

Gain a devil fruit for each major boss you kill!

🏴‍☠️20+ STORY ARCS!
Romance Dawn to Laugh Tale — battle Crocodile, Doflamingo, Kaido, Blackbeard & more.

⚓JOIN THE GROUP FOR BONUSES!

🍎COUNTLESS DEVIL FRUITS
Roll across 6 rarities. Rubber, Fire, Thunder, Buddha, Divine Wolf all with unique mechanics and skills

👊MASTER HAKI
Dozens of levels. Specialize in Armament, Observation, or Conqueror's.

🩸BLOODLINES
Meditate, earn scrolls, unlock power — from Noble Blood to the mythical D. Clan.

🎣FISHING
Cast for rare loot, Devil Fruit Rolls & Ancient-tier catches.

👥RECRUIT BOSSES
Build your crew! Recruit powerful bosses to aid you

⭐Favorite so you don't miss updates!

This game is in alpha, so expect some minor bugs & join the group to report any problems!
